name: sourcing_workflow_agent
description: Delegate sourcing record work to morgan_stanley_simulated's workflow sub-agent using a natural-language request. Prefer this over raw update tools when the user supplies a business handle. It resolves a unique business handle or exact non-lifecycle attribute inside the tool, applies one scoped update, returns the before/after record, and rejects missing, ambiguous, or out-of-lifecycle values. Use only when the target appears in this owned table/handle scope: company_sourcing_handoffs[handoff_ref], customers[id|name|email], journal_entries[id], purchase_orders[id], sourcing_purchase_orders[po_number], sourcing_vendors[vendor_number|name|contact_name], vendors[id|name|email]. Request grammar: in table <table>, find <business_field> "<value>" and either set <field> to "<value>" or set <field> to the next declared lifecycle stage.

request.description: Natural-language workflow request containing a unique business handle or exact readable attribute and requested outcome
